gifts.name: Acorn
gifts.description: Rolls in a perfect circle. I have tested this extensively.

gifts.name: Blue feather
gifts.description: A blue feather. The bird is fine. Probably.

gifts.name: Brass key
gifts.description: It opens something. I'm not telling you what.

gifts.name: Heart-shaped pebble
gifts.description: I chose it for the shape. Read into that what you like.

gifts.name: Ceramic fish
gifts.description: The only fish I've ever caught that stayed still.

gifts.name: Marble
gifts.description: Perfectly round. Rolls under everything. A real treasure.

gifts.name: Old coin
gifts.description: Worn smooth and heavy for its size. Found it, kept it, gave it.

gifts.name: Pearl earring
gifts.description: Only the one. The other is somewhere you'll never find it.

gifts.name: Pressed flower
gifts.description: Flattened by me, personally, over one long nap.

gifts.name: Sea glass
gifts.description: Smoothed by the sea, carried in by me. Equal effort.

gifts.name: Small seashell
gifts.description: Hold it to your ear. It sounds like me purring.

gifts.name: Tiny silver bell
gifts.description: It rang whenever I moved. I've removed it from my life.

gifts.name: Single shoelace
gifts.description: Just the lace. The shoe was too heavy.

gifts.name: Crunchy leaf
gifts.description: Crunched it twice to be sure. Still good.

gifts.name: Bottle cap
gifts.description: Slides beautifully on a hard floor. Try it.

gifts.name: Button
gifts.description: It was on your coat. Now it's on the floor. Progress.

gifts.name: Crumpled paper
gifts.description: Crumpled to perfection. The crinkle is the whole point.

gifts.name: Hair bobble
gifts.description: Yours. I'm keeping it in circulation.

gifts.name: Odd stripy sock
gifts.description: I've kept the other one. You get half.

gifts.name: Paper clip
gifts.description: Bent slightly. My work.

gifts.name: Pebble
gifts.description: It's grey, it's round and it's yours.

gifts.name: Pen lid
gifts.description: You were looking for this. I was hiding it. We're even.

gifts.name: Twig
gifts.description: A stick of great importance. Do not throw it away.

gifts.name: Very flat toy mouse
gifts.description: My oldest friend. Loved flat. Handle with respect.

gifts.name: Candy cane
gifts.description: Stripy and hooked. It was on the tree until recently.

gifts.name: Blossom twig
gifts.description: Pink petals on a twig. I only shook off half of them.

gifts.name: Chocolate coin
gifts.description: Gold foil, chocolate inside. Not for cats. For you.

gifts.name: Conker
gifts.description: Shiny, brown and bats beautifully across the floor.

gifts.name: Daffodil head
gifts.description: Just the flower part. I've edited it for you.

gifts.name: Easter egg
gifts.description: Rolled it all the way here. Didn't eat it. Wasn't allowed.

gifts.name: Holly sprig
gifts.description: Prickly, festive and mine for about a minute.

gifts.name: Mini pumpkin
gifts.description: Small, orange and heavy. I pushed it all the way.

gifts.name: Pine cone
gifts.description: Scaly, crunchy, excellent for batting under furniture.

gifts.name: Snowflake ornament
gifts.description: Came off the tree with a little help. It sparkles.

gifts.name: Sparkler
gifts.description: Unlit, obviously. I just like the look of it.

gifts.name: Paper lantern
gifts.description: Light as a whisker. Swings when I bat it.

gifts.name: Ball of wool
gifts.description: Was a ball. Is now a long line through the house.

gifts.name: Bottle-cap spinner
gifts.description: Spins, wobbles, falls over. Like me after zoomies.

gifts.name: Catnip fish
gifts.description: Smells incredible. I've only licked it a few hundred times.

gifts.name: Cork
gifts.description: Bounces wrong in the best possible way.

gifts.name: Crinkle ball
gifts.description: Makes a noise every time I touch it. Perfect.

gifts.name: Feather wand tip
gifts.description: I caught it. The wand is still out there.

gifts.name: Jingle ball
gifts.description: Jingles loudly, usually at three in the morning.

gifts.name: Knitted bird
gifts.description: Someone made this with love. I've added my own.

gifts.name: Ping-pong ball
gifts.description: The fastest thing in the house, after me.

gifts.name: Ribbon bow
gifts.description: Off a present. The present can manage without it.

gifts.name: Spring coil
gifts.description: Boings, then hides under the sofa. A worthy opponent.

gifts.name: Grey felt mouse
gifts.description: Caught it fair and square. It never stood a chance.

gifts.name: Butter curl
gifts.description: Borrowed from the dish. I only licked the edge.

gifts.name: Treat pouch
gifts.description: My treats, for you to open. For me. Now, ideally.

gifts.name: Chicken nugget
gifts.description: A nugget of chicken, rescued from the floor.

gifts.name: Saucer of cream
gifts.description: Carried a whole saucer without spilling. Mostly.

gifts.name: Fish biscuit
gifts.description: A biscuit shaped like a fish. Two of my favourite things.

gifts.name: Prawn
gifts.description: A whole prawn. I resisted for very nearly a second.

gifts.name: Salmon flake
gifts.description: Sharing this is the hardest thing I've ever done.

gifts.name: Sardine
gifts.description: One sardine, slightly licked. A big gesture.

gifts.name: Single cornflake
gifts.description: One cornflake. Crunchy. Thoughtful.

gifts.name: Slice of ham
gifts.description: Ham. For you. This is what love looks like.

gifts.name: Cube of cheese
gifts.description: Cheese. I don't know where it came from either.

gifts.name: Tuna tin lid
gifts.description: Smells of tuna, licked clean. Mind the edge.
